title: Ilyrium LoRA Library
description: Global registry mapping shot-spec keyframe.ref_lora names to resolved character LoRA assets. Consumed by keyframe_to_comfy.py for t2i LoRA injection and by batch_render.py's lock_lora_library() helper. Global (not per-song): characters are shared across New Harmony songs.

filename.description: Filename present in ComfyUI/models/loras/ on the render box.

base_model.description: Tensor.art base model id the LoRA was trained against.

sha256.description: sha256 of the .safetensors. Null until trained.

status.description: pending = registered but not yet trained; trained = .safetensors present + fingerprinted.

character.description: Character key this LoRA renders. Optional; present since the stripe_young entry (2026-07) and formalised 2026-09-03 when the four New Harnomy principals were registered. Distinct from `name`, which is the shot_spec ref_lora lookup key.
